form.sliceFormat: {dim} slice must be in 「start, stop」 integer format
form.sliceStartStop: {dim} slice start must not exceed stop
form.windowNeedsSlice: A window read requires at least one finite slice (time/y/x) — full-cube reads are rejected
form.labeledNeedsSelection: A labeled read requires at least one of tag / bbox / index slices
form.bboxFormat: bbox must be four numbers 「minx, miny, maxx, maxy」
form.indexSliceFormat: Index slices must be in 「dim:start, stop」 format, with groups separated by semicolons
form.indexSliceRange: Index slice {dim} must be in 「start, stop」 integer format
form.maxCellsRange: max_cells must be in the range 1 – 8,000,000
form.maxRowsRange: max_rows must be in the range 1 – 200,000
form.reviseRefRequired: Enter the cube ref to revise
form.reviseNeedsBandSource: Revise requires both band and source
form.rsNeedsTimeSource: RS assembly requires at least one time + source

modeDesc.revise: Revise a time slice (hard-link CoW fork; source store untouched)
